conditions.message: communication/nccl-all-reduce: OCI RDMA network detection found no NetworkAttachmentDefinition annotated k8s.v1.cni.cncf.io/resourceName: nvidia.com/mlnxnics, and the cluster has no NetworkAttachmentDefinitions at all. Create a NetworkAttachmentDefinition annotated k8s.v1.cni.cncf.io/resourceName: nvidia.com/mlnxnics, list the networks explicitly with networkAttachments, or set mlnxPerNode: 0, which certifies without RDMA NICs unless rdmaDeviceAccess: hostPath is also set on a cluster that exposes /dev/infiniband without a device plugin (ADR-088).
